title: Agar police aapko roke
body: Shant rahein aur izzat se baat karein. Aap pooch sakte hain ke kyun roka gaya hai. Officers ke naam, vehicle number, waqt aur jagah note karein. Aap family member ya lawyer se rabta karne ki request kar sakte hain. Jo paper samajh na aaye us par sign na karein.

title: Agar aapko giraftar kiya jaye
body: Giraftari par shant rahein aur physically resist na karein. Giraftari ki wajah poochein. Aap family ko khabar karne aur lawyer se rabta karne ki request kar sakte hain. Jo document samajh na aaye us par sign na karein. Thana ka naam, waqt aur officers ki details yaad rakhein.
steps: Unclear paper par sign na karein

title: FIR kaise darj karwayein
body: FIR kisi criminal waqia ki pehli record hoti hai. Jis ilaqe mein waqia hua wahan ke thane jayen, baatein saaf bayan karein aur FIR ki copy mangein. Copy mehfooz rakhein.

title: Agar police FIR darj na kare
body: Agar police FIR darj na kare to wajah poochein. Aap lawyer, legal-aid organization ya relevant police complaint authority se rabta kar sakte hain. Messages, photos, naam, dates aur witnesses ka saboot save rakhein. Shant rahein aur sab kuch document karein.
steps: Lawyer ya legal aid se rabta

title: Giraftari ke baad zamanat
body: Zamanat custody se rihaai ke legal process ko kehte hain. Aam tor par lawyer relevant court mein application file karta hai. FIR copy, giraftari ki details aur court notices mehfooz rakhein aur court dates miss na karein. Foran licensed advocate se rabta karein.
steps: Lawyer se zamanat ka process poochein

title: Office harassment ke options
body: Office mein harassment ho to saboot save karein: messages, emails, dates, naam aur witnesses. Check karein ke office mein harassment policy ya committee hai. Aap relevant authority ko report kar sakte hain ya lawyer se rabta kar sakte hain.

title: Street harassment aur foran safety
body: Agar unsafe mehsoos ho to bheed wali roshan jagah jayen aur kisi trusted insaan ko call karein. Safe ho to messages, screenshots ya vehicle number save karein. Khatre mein SOS use karein aur police emergency number par call consider karein.

title: Gharili tashadud ke case mein
body: Foran khatra ho to mumkin ho to safe jagah jayen aur kisi trusted insaan se rabta karein. Safe ho to messages, injury ki photos, medical records aur dates save karein. Aap lawyer, women-protection service ya legal-aid se madad le sakte hain.

title: Online fraud ya scam
body: Online fraud ho to mazeed payment band karein aur codes share na karein. Profile, chat, receipts aur transaction IDs ke screenshots save karein. Account ko platform par report karein aur relevant cybercrime authority ko report consider karein. Password change karein aur 2FA on karein.

title: Cyber harassment ya hacked account
body: Online harassment ya hacked account par reply na karein. Dates aur usernames ke sath screenshots lein, account block aur report karein, password change karein aur 2FA on karein. Serious threat ya blackmail par saboot save kar ke lawyer se rabta karein.

title: Consumer complaint
body: Kharab product ya service ho to receipt, warranty, photos aur seller ke messages save rakhein. Seller se likh kar refund ya repair mangein. Inkar par relevant consumer forum ya authority mein complaint kar sakte hain. Sab ki copies rakhein.

title: Salary na milne ya unfair termination
body: Salary na mile ya job unfairly khatam ho to contract, salary slips, attendance aur messages save rakhein. Employer se likh kar pending amount mangein. Hal na ho to lawyer ya relevant labour authority se options poochein.
